crossRefs.note: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys…
I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not…
“Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will…
The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at…
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you, and I will save those who are lame, and gather those…
At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all…
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people…

translations.web: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’ ”
translations.bsb: I will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against you, and you will no longer endure the reproach of the peoples or cause your nation to stumble, declares the Lord GOD.”
translations.kjv: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: neither will I let thee hear any more the shame of the nations, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nation to stumble any more, saith the Lord Jehovah.
